conditions.representation: number CDF8,signed symmetric J,real orthogonal U
conditions.initialization: same original qualified J/U at eta=0;NOT saved trial2 U or any optimized endpoint
conditions.per_new_eta: original J initialization,then exactly two successive same-array Newton-CG refinements
conditions.purpose: limited PR-only reduced advancement and numerical qualification,not full convergence/performance comparison

algorithm.inner: SciPy1.14.1 Newton-CG,maxiter1000,xtol1e-12;verified same decoded J vg/hess,raw jac pre-step/accepted/endpoint rules unchanged
algorithm.oracle: reuse c_pr_inner_point_solver.PRReducedOracle;three corrected solve calls,existing independent precision_state and applicability at each distinct eta;exact eta byte cache
algorithm.admission: final inner J AND independent final-state J MET,existing latest physical/chart pair shift<=1e-6,original PR rank/nullspace guard,block and refinement nonincrease;raw success neither sufficient nor necessary
algorithm.first_refinement: initial/first refined J statuses preserved as observations;final refined pair and final J gates decide,as in prior pipeline;no early raw-flag promotion
algorithm.additional_metadata: record all admission gates,raw flags,initial/accepted/last-unaccepted points independently;no new numerical threshold

numerical_allowances.rank_rule: existing head rank LD*d-(LD-1),only U-independent universal head gauges;extra/ambiguous null refused;tail injectivity;no pseudoinverse/drop/ridge

calls.saved_load: 1,decode original g/J/U and saved objective scales JSON
calls.initial_identity: 1,finite binary64 shapes,J symmetry,U orthogonality and original scale metadata
calls.outer_driver: 1,one PR-only BFGS orchestration including initial eta;expected qualification stops COMPLETE,correctness exception FAIL
calls.inner_J_solve: <=24,3 per distinct U point:initial and2 refinements;chart caches,vg/Hessian/raw/independent J diagnostics included;actual iteration/evaluation counts saved
calls.precision_state: <=16,2 per point:existing same-array extended/binary64 value,J/U gradient and independent forward/pullback checks
calls.reduced_admission: <=8,1 per point:rank/nullspace/latest-pair shift,J/inner/admission metadata without extra objective query
calls.classification: 1,advancement and STOP status,separate raw/J/stability/structure/numerical admission,DF/performance unknown
calls.export: 1,already computed terminal J/U and JSON only,no fresh gradient or tensor/operator evaluation

execution_order: outer_driver:initial eta then BFGS;each new eta=inner solve,refine1,state1,refine2,state2,admission

outcomes.progress: ACCEPTED_U_ADVANCE_OBSERVED only for callbacks accepting at least1 new U;unaccepted trials never count
outcomes.qualification: NUMERICAL_PILOT_ADMITTED is numerical latest-pair/structure evidence,NOT rigorous gradient enclosure
outcomes.initial_unqualified: no BFGS;diagnostic initial pair saved,never silently replaced by legacy initial
outcomes.trial_unqualified: stop BFGS on first unqualified trial,retain last accepted terminal and stopped trial separately
outcomes.point_limit: OUTER_LIMIT_UNQUALIFIED before ninth point,not a convergence/performance FAIL
outcomes.normal_limited_return: LIMITED_OUTER_RETURN may include raw maxiter or precision loss;normal optimizer success reported separately
outcomes.correctness: any source/input/nonfinite/value/gradient/raw/orthogonality/progress mismatch:stop dependent calls,preserve raw/partial evidence;no retry
outcomes.U_first_order: diagnostic only;simultaneous convergence not required by this advancement pilot

forbidden: more than8 distinct eta/2 accepted updates/24 inner calls
new physical/sector DF error,CAR/ground/PF/RTE/circuit build/compile/shots/total cost
important scientific review or automatic next stage
required_outputs: SOURCE/contract copies and fixed input identity
raw x0/x/J/z/jac/W,pre-step/accepted vectors and consistency for every solve
two independent precision states per point
all eta/J/U points and accepted labels,raw outer result when returned
separate terminal and unaccepted stop-trial identities
result,resources,call journal,failure partial if any,mandatory STOP
resources: No arbitrary CPU/RAM/worker/wall cap;one dependent PR trajectory with vectorized NumPy/SciPy/JAX/extended CPU path;choose thread coordination from actual free resources;task-local cache only;no shared environment/process changes
authorization: Separate explicit chat permission required for this fresh54-unit PR-only scientific run;no approval proof/record/certificate or grant
